offering_description.value: Provides home medical equipment, respiratory therapy, diabetes supplies and pharmacy services to patients in the United States. Delivers products and services to patients' homes, with reimbursement largely from government programs and commercial health plans.

primary_products.value: respiratory devices and CPAP equipment; home oxygen equipment; mobility equipment; diabetes testing and insulin supplies; wound care supplies

primary_services.value: home respiratory therapy; sleep therapy support; care management; pharmacy services

customer_segment.value: B2C: patients with chronic conditions receiving care at home; B2G: Medicare and Medicaid programs as payers; B2B: commercial health insurers and health plans

end_markets.value: healthcare; home healthcare; pharmacy; diabetes care

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: government and commercial payers reimburse equipment and supplies provided to patients; rental or leasing: rented respiratory and mobility equipment; product sales: diabetes supplies and other medical supplies sold to patients; service fees: respiratory therapy and care management services
revenue_model.category: healthcare reimbursement; rental or leasing; product sales; service fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: delivers home care and therapy to patients, billed to payers; distributor: supplies equipment and supplies to patients and care providers; retailer: pharmacy sales of diabetes and other supplies to patients

geography_served.value: US national: Operates across many US states through a national network of locations

specialization.value: related lines: home medical equipment, respiratory therapy, diabetes supplies and pharmacy services sold to the same patients

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company branches and service centers across the US; direct sales: direct contracting with payers and care providers; other: home delivery of equipment and supplies to patients

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Medicare and Medicaid supplier enrollment and accreditation, FDA-regulated medical devices, and HIPAA privacy rules
